blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit.
We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations.
Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training.
We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation.
On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 0.661 to 0.622 0.622 ( 5.9 % 5.9\% ) and collision rate from 0.456 0.456 to 0.217 0.217 ( 52.4 % 52.4\% ) relative to our retrained LAW baseline.
It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.
blocks.zh:
后期世界模型学习自主驱动的预测性表述,但这些状态所保留的关系语义往往仍然隐含着.
我们调查交通场景图是否可作为对潜在世界表现的特权语义监督.
在LAW的基础上,我们从nuScenes 3D注释中构建以演员为中心的场景图,用冷冻文本嵌入模型编码其序列式关系结构,并在训练期间将视觉潜伏的表示与这个语义目标一致.
我们撤除监督分支的推论,所以它既不需要场景图表,也不需要3D注释,也不增加测试时间计算.
在nuScenes上,我们的方法将L2的平均轨迹误差从0.661 0.661降至0.622 0.622(5.9% 5.9\%),碰撞率从0.456 0.456降至0.217 0.217(52.4\%),与我们重新训练的LAW基线相比。
它还超越了一个无结构字幕风格的语义目标,支持为潜在世界示范表现学习提供明确的关系结构的好处。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
End-to-end autonomous driving has evolved from unified perception–planning architectures toward foundation model-based agents with increasingly rich semantic representations.
Methods such as UniAD [ 1 ] and VADv2 [ 2 ] jointly learn perception and planning representations, while language-aware approaches such as LMDrive [ 3 ] , DriveLM [ 4 ] , SimLingo [ 5 ] , and OpenDriveVLA [ 6 ] increasingly couple semantic reasoning with driving actions.
LAD-Drive [ 7 ] further bridges the gap between high-level semantic intent and continuous planning through an action-aware diffusion decoder.
Together, these works highlight the value of semantically structured representations for driving while generally retaining semantic reasoning in the deployed model.
blocks.zh:
终到终的自主驱动已经从统一感知-规划架构演变为基础模型代理,语义表现越来越丰富。
例如UniAD[1]和VADv2[2]联合学习感知和规划表述,而语言意识的方法如LMDrive[3],DriverLM[4],SimLingo[5]和OpenDriveVLA. [6] 越来越多的语义推理与驱动动作.
LAD-Drive [7]通过动作感知传播解码器,进一步弥合了高级语义意图与持续规划之间的差距.
这些作品共同凸显了在一般保留已部署模型中的语义推理的同时,对驾驶进行精密结构化表述的价值.

blocks.en:
A complementary line of research investigates world models that learn predictive representations of driving scenes.
Generative driving world models predict future visual observations [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , whereas latent world models reason in compact feature spaces that integrate efficiently with downstream planning.
LAW [ 12 ] predicts future visual latents conditioned on the current scene representation and ego motion, while WoTE [ 13 ] predicts future BEV states for trajectory evaluation.
World4Drive [ 14 ] introduces spatial-semantic priors, and recent methods increasingly couple latent world modeling with planning, reasoning, and structured latent representations [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh:
互补的研究线调查了学习驾驶场景预测性表现的世界模型.
基因驱动世界模型预测未来的视觉观测[8、9、10、11],而潜在的世界模型则在紧凑的特征空间中提出理由,这些特征空间与下游规划有效结合。
Law [12] 预测以当前场景表现和自我运动为条件的未来视觉潜伏,而WoTE [13] 预测未来BEV状态进行轨迹评价.
World4Drive [14]引入了空间语义学前科,最近的方法越来越多地将潜在的世界模型与规划、推理和结构化的潜在表述结合起来[15、16、17、18、19、20、21、22]。

blocks.en:
Despite this progress, the relational semantics a latent world state should preserve often remain implicit.
Predicting future latent states encourages temporal scene modeling, while geometric priors and planning objectives provide spatial and task-level supervision, but do not explicitly constrain relationships between traffic participants.
For driving, such relationships are particularly important, since an actor’s relevance depends not only on its appearance but also on its relative position and interaction with the ego vehicle [ 23 ] .
GraphWorld [ 24 ] explicitly incorporates an ego-centric interaction graph into its latent world representation and planning architecture, while GraphPilot [ 25 ] shows that structured scene-graph supervision benefits language-based driving.
However, these approaches either embed relational structure in the model or target it for language-based reasoning.
Whether relational scene structure can instead serve as privileged semantic supervision for predictive world representations without requiring scene graphs at inference remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但一个潜在的世界国家的语义往往仍应保留。
预测未来潜在状态会鼓励时间场景建模,而几何前身和规划目标则提供空间和任务层面的监督,但并不明确限制交通参与者之间的关系。
对于驾驶来说,这种关系尤其重要,因为一个行为者的相关性不仅取决于其外表,而且还取决于其相对地位以及与自我载体的互动[23]。
GraphWorld [24] 明确将以自我为中心的互动图纳入其潜在的世界代表性和规划架构,而GraphPilot [25] 显示结构化的场景图监督有利于基于语言的驱动.
然而,这些方法要么将关系结构嵌入模型中,要么将其作为基于语言的推理目标。
关系场景结构能否作为预测性世界表现的特权语义监督,而不需要场景图表推论,基本上仍未加以探讨。

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigate this question by relationally grounding the latent state of LAW using traffic scene graphs available only during training.
We serialize actor-centric graphs constructed from nuScenes [ 26 ] 3D annotations into structured relational text and embed them using a frozen text encoder.
A lightweight alignment head maps LAW’s visual latents into the same semantic space and aligns them with the scene-graph representation, as shown in Fig. 1 .
After training, the complete supervision pathway is discarded, requiring neither scene graphs, 3D annotations, nor additional computation at inference.
The objective is not specific to LAW and, in principle, applies to other latent driving architectures that expose a trainable scene representation.
We additionally study an optional extension that grounds LAW’s predicted future latent state.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们调查这一问题,方法是利用仅在培训期间才提供的交通场景图,相对地确定法律厅的潜在状况。
我们把从nuScenes [26] 3D 注释中构建的以演员为中心的图表序列化成结构化的关系文本,并使用冷冻文本编码器嵌入.
如图1所示,轻量级对齐图头图将LAW的视觉潜伏物映射到同一个语义空间,并与场景图的显示物相对齐。
经过训练后,完全的监管路径被丢弃,不需要场景图,三维说明,也不需要附加推论计算.
目标并非是LAW所特有的,原则上适用于暴露可训练场景表现的其他潜在驾驶架构。
此外,我们还研究了LAW未来潜在状态的可选扩展。

blocks.en:
On nuScenes, structured scene-graph supervision reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 0.661 to 0.622 0.622 and average collision rate from 0.456 0.456 to 0.217 0.217 relative to our controlled LAW retraining.
Compared with an unstructured caption-style semantic target, it further reduces L2 error by 7.2 % 7.2\% and collision rate by 30.4 % 30.4\% .
Our work introduces training-only relational grounding for latent driving world models without modifying inference, shows the benefit of structured relational supervision over generic textual semantics, and analyzes how grounding affects observed and predicted future latent states.
blocks.zh:
在nuScens上,结构化的场景图监督将L2的平均轨迹误差从0.661 0.661降至0.622 0.622,与我们控制的LAW再培训相比,平均碰撞率从0.456 04.56降至0.217 0217 0.217。
与无结构字幕风格的语义目标相比,它进一步将L2误差减少7.2% 7.2% \%,碰撞率减少30.4% 30.4% \%.
我们的工作为潜在的驱动世界模型引入了只培训的关联基础,而不修改推论,显示了对通用文字语义进行结构化关系监督的好处,并分析了定位如何影响观察到的和预测的未来潜在状态。

Fig. 2: Overview of our relationally grounded latent world model.
The upper branch shows the original LAW [ 12 ] pipeline, which extracts visual latents from multi-view images, predicts ego waypoints, constructs action-aware latents, and predicts future visual latents.
During training, we construct traffic scene graphs from the corresponding 3D annotations, serialize them, and encode them using a frozen text embedding model.

The right-hand auxiliary branch shows our optional temporal extension, which analogously aligns the predicted future latents with the semantic representation of the scene graph at t + 1 t+1 .
The scene-graph, text-embedding, and alignment components are discarded after training and introduce no additional inference-time cost.

blocks.en: II Relationally Grounded Latent World Model
blocks.zh: 二. 关系基础的后期世界模式

blocks.en:
We investigate whether structured relational scene information can serve as privileged semantic supervision for the latent state of a driving world model.
Building on LAW [ 12 ] , we introduce an auxiliary objective to align visual scene representations with the semantic embeddings of traffic scene graphs.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , we construct scene graphs from the 3D annotations for each training frame and use them only for semantic supervision.
We remove all additional components at inference.
We further investigate an optional temporal extension that also aligns the world model’s predicted future representation with the scene graph at time t + 1 t+1 .
blocks.zh:
我们调查结构化的关系场景信息是否可作为对驱动世界模式潜在状态的特权语义监督。
在LAW[12]的基础上,我们引入了一个辅助目标,使视觉场景表现与交通场景图的语义嵌入一致.
如图2所示,我们从3D说明中为每个培训框架构建场景图,仅用于语义监督。
我们删除所有额外的组件 推论。
我们进一步调查一个可选的时间延长,这个时间延长也使世界模型预测的未来表现与时间t+1 t+1的场景图一致.

blocks.en: II-B Scene-Graph Semantic Supervision
blocks.zh: II-B 场景-图形语义监督

blocks.en:
For each training frame, we construct a relational traffic scene graph 𝒢 t = ( 𝒩 t , ℰ t ) \mathcal{G}_{t}=(\mathcal{N}_{t},\mathcal{E}_{t}) from the corresponding nuScenes 3D annotations, where 𝒩 t \mathcal{N}_{t} denotes the set of graph nodes and ℰ t \mathcal{E}_{t} the set of pairwise relations.
We adopt the Actor-Only representation of GraphPilot [ 25 ] , in which the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic participants, such as vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians, serve as nodes, while edges encode relations based on their relative orientation and proximity.
This provides a compact representation of the relational structure of the current traffic scene.

这为目前交通场景的关系结构提供了紧凑的体现.

blocks.en: III Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 三. 实验评价

blocks.en: We evaluate whether structured scene-graph supervision improves LAW and analyze the effects of relational structure, alignment strength, and temporal semantic grounding on downstream planning performance.
blocks.zh: 我们评价结构化的场景图监督是否改进了Law,并分析了关系结构、配合强度和时间语义对下游规划绩效的影响。

blocks.en: III-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: III-A 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate our approach on the nuScenes [ 26 ] planning benchmark using the perception-free LAW architecture [ 12 ] .
While LAW itself operates directly on multi-view images, our method additionally uses the available nuScenes 3D annotations during training to construct the scene-graph supervision targets described in Sec. II-B .
We use these annotations only as privileged training supervision and do not require them at inference.
Following LAW, we report the L2 displacement error of the predicted ego trajectory and the collision rate at prediction horizons of 1, 2, and 3 seconds, together with their averages.
Lower values are better for both metrics.
blocks.zh:
我们使用无感性法律架构来评估我们关于nuScenes[26]规划基准的方法[12]。
虽然LAW本身直接在多视图图像上运行,但我们的方法在培训期间还额外使用了可用的nuScens 3D说明来构建Sec. II-B所述场景图监督目标.
我们只是将这些说明作为特殊的培训监督,不需要它们作推论。
根据LAW,我们报告L2的迁移误差,即预期的自我轨迹和1、2、3秒的碰撞率及其平均值。
这两个指标的数值都较低。

blocks.en:
For all experiments, we train LAW from scratch using the official hyperparameters and training schedule on four NVIDIA H200 GPUs.
Apart from the additional semantic supervision objective, all variants use the same LAW architecture and training setup.
To ensure a controlled comparison, we retrain the LAW baseline under the same setup and report all improvements relative to this model rather than the published results or released checkpoint.
Unless stated otherwise, we use the structured scene-graph serialization from Sec. II-B , a frozen Qwen3-Embedding-8B model, λ SG = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{SG}}=0.1 , and we set λ temp = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{temp}}=0 and use
temporal alignment only in the corresponding ablation.
We use all scene-graph and semantic-alignment components only during training and remove them at inference.

blocks.en: III-B Structured Relational Supervision
blocks.zh: 结构化关系监督

blocks.en:
We first evaluate whether aligning the visual latent state with a semantic scene-graph embedding improves downstream planning.
To distinguish structured relational supervision from generic textual semantic alignment, we additionally train an unstructured-text variant using the same frozen embedding model and alignment objective.
Instead of explicit subject–relation–object statements, this baseline describes the scene in caption-style prose, providing the same semantic information without the explicit graph structure and relation-centric representation used by our method.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评估视觉潜伏状态与语义场景图嵌入是否改善了下游规划。
为了区分结构化关系监督与通用文本语义对齐,我们利用相同的冷冻嵌入模型和对齐目标,额外训练一种非结构化文本变体.
这个基准不是明确的主题- 关系- 对象语句, 而是用标题式的形容词来描述场景, 提供相同的语义信息, 而不使用我们的方法所使用的明确的图表结构和以关系为中心的表达方式 。

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. I , structured scene-graph supervision improves performance consistently across all prediction horizons.
Compared with our retrained LAW baseline, the average L2 error decreases from 0.661 0.661 to 0.622 0.622 , corresponding to a relative reduction of 5.9 % 5.9\% .
The improvement in collision rate is considerably larger, decreasing from 0.456 0.456 to 0.217 0.217 , a relative reduction of 52.4 % 52.4\% .
blocks.zh:
如塔布所示. 我,结构化的场景图监督 不断改善所有预测的性能
与我们重新调整的LAW基线相比,平均L2误差从0.661 0.661降至0.622 0.622,相对减少5.9%5.9%。
碰撞率的提高要大得多,从0.456 0.456降至0.217 0.217,相对下降52.4%,52.4%。

blocks.en:
The comparison with unstructured text further suggests that this gain is not explained solely by introducing an auxiliary semantic target.
Although unstructured semantic alignment reduces the average collision rate to 0.312 0.312 , it slightly increases the average L2 error from 0.661 0.661 to 0.670 0.670 .
In contrast, structured scene-graph supervision improves both metrics.
Relative to the unstructured representation, it reduces the average L2 error by 7.2 % 7.2\% and the average collision rate by 30.4 % 30.4\% .
These results suggest that the structured scene-graph representation provides a more effective semantic target for the visual latent state than the unstructured textual baseline.
blocks.zh:
与无结构文本的比较进一步表明,这一增益并不仅仅通过引入辅助语义目标来解释.
虽然无结构的语义校正将平均碰撞率降低到0.312 0.312,但略微将L2平均误差从0.661 0.661提高到0.670 0.670.
相比之下,结构化的场景图监督改进了两种度量.
相对于非结构化的表示,它将L2平均误差减少7.2% 7.2\%,平均碰撞率减少30.4% 30.4\%.
这些结果表明,结构化的场景图表现为视觉潜伏状态提供了比无结构文字基线更有效的语义目标.

blocks.en:
We hypothesize that this advantage arises from the actor-centric relational inductive bias of the scene graph.
Whereas caption-style text describes scene content in a less constrained form, the scene graph explicitly emphasizes relative orientation and proximity between traffic participants, which are directly relevant to interaction-aware driving.
The resulting target may therefore encourage LAW’s visual latents to preserve relational information that its original trajectory and future-latent objectives only indirectly constrain.
This interpretation is also consistent with the particularly large reduction in collision rate, since collision avoidance depends strongly on representing the spatial relationships between the ego vehicle and surrounding actors.
blocks.zh:
我们假设这种优势 来自于场景图中 以演员为中心的感应偏差
虽然字幕风格的文字描述场景内容的形式不太紧凑,但场景图明确强调交通参与者之间的相对定向和亲近性,这与互动意识驱动直接相关.
因此,由此产生的目标可能鼓励LAW的视觉潜质保存关系信息,即其最初的轨迹和与未来相关的目标只能间接地制约这种信息。
这种解释也符合碰撞率的大幅下降,因为避免碰撞在很大程度上取决于代表自负载体与周围行为者之间的空间关系。

blocks.en:
We further analyze the influence of the semantic alignment objectives by varying the current-state loss weight λ SG \lambda_{\mathrm{SG}} and evaluating the optional temporal alignment introduced in Sec. II-C .
Tab. II presents the results.

The upper part of Tab. II shows that the effect of current-state semantic supervision is not monotonic in λ SG \lambda_{\mathrm{SG}} .
A small weight of 0.05 0.05 already reduces the average collision rate from 0.456 0.456 to 0.283 0.283 , while leaving the trajectory error almost unchanged.
Increasing the weight to 0.1 0.1 yields the best overall trade-off, reducing the average L2 error to 0.622 0.622 and the collision rate to 0.217 0.217 .
Larger weights do not provide consistent additional gains, suggesting that scene-graph alignment is most effective as an auxiliary constraint rather than a dominant training objective.

小重量0.050.05已经将平均碰撞率从0.456 0.456降至0.283 0.283,同时轨迹误差几乎保持不变.
将重量提高到0.1,得出最佳的总体权衡,将L2平均误差降至0.622 0.622,碰撞率降至0.217 0.217.
较大的权重并不能提供一致的额外收益,说明场景图的对齐作为辅助约束而不是主导性的培训目标最为有效.

blocks.en:
The lower part of Tab. II evaluates semantic supervision of the predicted future state.
Future-state alignment alone improves trajectory error only at moderate weight: λ temp = 0.1 \lambda_{\mathrm{temp}}=0.1 reduces average L2 from 0.661 0.661 to 0.628 0.628 , but does not improve collision performance.
Increasing the future-only weight to 0.5 0.5 largely removes the L2 gain and substantially worsens collision performance, indicating that overly strong supervision of the predicted latent state can be detrimental.

仅未来状态对齐仅在中度重量下改善轨迹误差: QQ 临时=0.1\lambda_{\mathrm{temp}}=0.1 平均L2从0.661 0.661降至0.628 0.628,但没有提高碰撞性能.

Joint current–future supervision exhibits a different trade-off.
Increasing both alignment weights progressively improves trajectory accuracy, with λ SG = λ temp = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{SG}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{temp}}=0.5 achieving the lowest average L2 error of 0.594 0.594 , a 10.1 % 10.1\% reduction over the baseline.
However, its collision rate of 0.387 0.387 remains substantially above the 0.217 0.217 obtained with current-state alignment alone.
Overall, these results suggest that relational grounding is most effective for collision reduction when applied to the current visual state, whereas temporal grounding can further improve trajectory accuracy but requires careful weighting and does not provide the same safety benefit.

blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en:
We investigated whether relational scene structure can serve as privileged semantic supervision for predictive latent world representations in autonomous driving.
By aligning LAW’s visual latents with semantic embeddings of actor-centric traffic scene graphs during training, we improve both trajectory accuracy and collision performance without requiring scene graphs, 3D annotations, or additional inference computation.
Our experiments further show that structured scene-graph supervision outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the hypothesis that explicitly encoding relations among traffic participants provides a useful inductive bias for learning latent world-model representations.
Temporal grounding of predicted future states can further improve trajectory accuracy, but it exhibits a different trade-off with collision performance.
blocks.zh:
我们调查了关系场景结构是否可作为在自主驾驶中预测潜在世界表现的特权语义监督.
通过在训练中将LAW的视觉潜质与以演员为中心的交通场景图的语义嵌入,我们既提高了轨迹精度,也提高了碰撞性能,而不需要场景图,3D说明,或者额外的推论计算.
我们的实验进一步表明,结构化的场景图监督超越了一个无结构的字幕式语义目标,支持一种假设,即交通参与者之间明确编码关系,为学习潜在的世界模式表述提供了有益的诱导性偏差。
预测未来状态的时间定位可以进一步提高轨迹准确性,但它与碰撞性能有不同的权衡。

blocks.en:
Our current formulation obtains the semantic target by serializing the scene graph and encoding it with a frozen text model, making the target potentially sensitive to serialization choices.
Future work will therefore investigate graph-native encoders, such as relational GNNs or graph transformers, that directly exploit graph topology, learn task-relevant entity and relation weighting, and provide compact relational supervision without requiring textual serialization.
We further plan to study the transfer of this training-only objective to other latent driving world models beyond LAW.
blocks.zh:
我们目前的配方通过串行场景图并用冷冻文本模型编码来获得语义目标,使目标对序列化选择具有潜在敏感性.
因此,今后的工作将调查直接利用图表地形、学习与任务相关的实体和关系权重的图表内在编码器,如关系GNN或图表转换器,并提供紧凑的关系监督,而不需要文字序列化。
我们进一步计划研究将这个仅培训的目标转移到法律以外的其他潜在的推动世界模式。
